independent_recomputation.method: Shapely 2.2.0; official 12-vertex raw source ring compared with all 12 bottom foundation vertices from the saved asset vertex probe

bounds_interpretation.interpretation: The 21.35 m all-object bound includes hidden roof/dormer/chimney/HVAC option meshes. The meshes are disabled for rendering and hidden from viewport via hide_get; render-visible geometry tops at 15.837 m. They do not explain the visible hero roof appearance.

findings: Full GIS ring agreement is effectively exact in the documented approximate local conversion, but does not validate wall lines above the foundation or the height.

The main entrance is still much broader and more classical than the current Purdue CLA photo: full-width triangular portico versus narrow rectangular stone portal with arched transom and two slender supports.
The facade window grid remains repetitive compared with the source’s grouped openings and distinct upper band.
The large dark roof remains nearly featureless; historic imagery is undated and does not verify the present roof or height.
The interior cutaway is visible but sparse and schematic; source materials do not verify current room arrangement.
The asset reopens cleanly, has no materialless meshes or missing external images, and retains an identity local root; master marker placement was not reviewed.
required_before_pass: Correct entrance massing and details to match the photo-supported narrow stone surround, arched transom, recessed doors and two slender columns.
Improve grouped window rhythm and upper glass band without changing the GIS foundation/root.
Improve roof/eave surface and silhouette while maintaining explicit height/profile uncertainty.
Add depth to stone/glass/roof materials and remove/explain bright entry fixtures.
Provide a more legible schematic cutaway with partitions, door openings, floor relationship, and circulation.
Repeat reopen validation and coordinator master-marker verification after the next revision.
limitations: GIS source is an official campus-map polygon, not a certified survey or measured wall-line survey.
Current Purdue facade photo has no displayed capture date or scale.
Historic archives photo is undated and supports only historical character, not current roof geometry.
Height, roof profile, current interior layout, and interior fixture placement remain estimated or schematic.
The current master was not reopened in this independent review.
